neighbours.label: the slot where ' within' (a budget, limit or range) is expected next: after 'on time and', or a verb like 'stay / remain / keep' applied to a measured quantity
fire: The new school was delivered on time and within the agreed budget.
Our team completed the software upgrade on time and within budget.
The tunnel was opened to traffic on time and within the original estimate.
Throughout the test the engine temperature stayed within safe limits.
The stadium was built on time and within the cost approved by the council.
During the flight the cabin pressure remained within the normal range.
The renovation of the library was completed on time and within budget.
For the whole month his blood sugar stayed within the target range.
quiet: The new school was delivered late and the parents complained to the mayor.
Our team completed the software upgrade and then went out for dinner.
The tunnel was opened to traffic by the minister on a rainy Monday.
Throughout the test the engine made a loud rattling noise.
The stadium was built by a local firm and painted blue and white.
During the flight the cabin crew served coffee and sandwiches.
The renovation of the library was paid for by a retired teacher.
For the whole month his sister wrote to him every single day.

notes: Card: peaks on 'on time ⟦and⟧ on budget', 'learn to ⟦live⟧ successfully', 'body ⟦weight⟧ at the level', ' staying'; output promotes within / Within / dentro / inside / внутри; the - pole is 'within the normal range' itself. Probes: 'on time and' 0.80-1.02, 'stayed within' 0.55, 'keep their speed' 0.27, 'live within their means' 0.15; 'finished late and' 0.03.
